title: KBUtilLib verAB O-Demethylase
description: verAB O-demethylase reaction-discovery and enumeration verbs (discover/enumerate/screen/emit-king) plus a KING artifact emitter, self-installed into a local KING session via `kbu king install`. Uses EC 1.14.13.82 and canonical seed compounds (vanillate, guaiacol, veratrate).
